Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1421
Claimant:
Johnathan Mosley
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
June 25, 2024
Claim opened for a parking lot collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck while stationary. The claimant
reports neck and back strain and is not represented by counsel, so all communication is going directly to the claimant.
June 26, 2024
Reviewed the first-notice statement. The claimant describes a rear impact at low speed in the lot, with the other
vehicle backing into the claimant's car.
July 2, 2024
Obtained the police report and statements from two independent witnesses. Both confirm the collision happened as
described and place the claimant inside the vehicle at the time.
September 29, 2024
Photos of the scene and the other driver's account match the claimant's descripiton of the impact point and direction.
September 30, 2024
Inspected the vehicle damage. The rear bumper and trunk panel damage is consistent with the force and angle
described in the reports.
October 13, 2024
Checked prior claims and records for this vehicle. No earlier damage to the vehicle is on file, and nothing suggests
the damage predates the policy's coverage start.
November 4, 2024
The claimant's medical records show the reported neck and back strain. No prior injury to the same body areas is
known from available history, and the injury pattern fits the kind of force involved in this collision.
November 24, 2024
Claimant called to add a few details about the seating position and the moment of impact. The additional details are
minor, and the core account has stayed the same since first notice.
December 19, 2024
Treatment has grown well beyond what this type of strain usually needs, with more visits and new services added
month after month. Requested treatment records and an independent medical review to look at the care plan.
December 28, 2024
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy. The file remains open pending the medical review and the bodily injury
evaluation.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
